psychology: Von Restorff — the single brass CTA and lone italic-gold word are the one-different-thing that gets remembered against the warm-neutral field
Hick's Law — decision point trimmed to two actions (Download / How it works), one clearly primary
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — polished editorial hero raises the trust prior for a health/clinical claim before any evidence is read
Cialdini Authority + anchoring — 'Research-backed', 'FL-41 clinical', '480nm notch filter' assert authority; 'Like $200 therapeutic tint glasses' price-anchors to justify value
Fogg B=MAP (ability) — '14 days free / No credit card' strips friction from the prompt
